high_level_description: This image is a digital post celebrating Diwali, the festival of lights. The background features a clear blue sky with scattered white clouds, suggesting a bright and sunny day. Below the sky, there is an aerial view of a cityscape with numerous buildings, indicating an urban setting. The foreground includes a lush green area with trees, adding a natural element to the scene. The central focus of the image is a colorful, decorative design resembling a rangoli, which is a traditional Indian art form often used during festivals like Diwali.
